dos.text: begin learning with Tawheed it is the first obligation upon every human.
understand Tawheed in its three categories.
purify your intentions for Allāh alone in all acts of worship.
learn the correct Names and Attributes of Allāh as revealed.
teach Tawheed to your family with wisdom.

donts.text: Don't associate any partner with Allāh in worship this is Shirk.
Don't compare Allāh to His creation in His Attributes.
Don't seek help, protection, or blessings from other than Allāh.
Don't make intermediaries between yourself and Allāh.
Don't neglect learning Tawheed while focusing only on secondary matters.

dos.text: Internalize that true Īmān increases with obedience and decreases with sin.
Reflect on the names and attributes of Allāh to strengthen your first pillar of faith.
Send prayers (ṣalāh) upon the Prophet ﷺ daily, affirming belief in messengers.
Remember death and the Hereafter frequently to align your actions.
Trust in Allāh’s decree while taking the lawful means (asbāb) for your affairs.

donts.text: Deny any part of the six articles of faith; doing so nullifies Īmān.
Speak about the how of Allāh’s attributes (e.g., How is His Hand?); affirm them without distortion.
Disrespect any prophet or angel; they are all honoured servants of Allāh.
Fall into despair or anxiety by misunderstanding Divine Decree; it includes both good and bad as a test.
Neglect the worldly life out of belief in the Hereafter; Islam commands balance.e

dos.text: Begin each day with intention for the five pillars
